description: This file contains JavaScript code for the ISC_SQLBrowser module of the SmartClient framework, defining classes, methods, and configurations for SQL browsing and editing within the application.

classes.name: SQLEditor
classes.description: Class representing a SQL editor component with input form and execution capabilities.

classes.name: SQLTableBrowser
classes.description: Class for browsing SQL tables with grid and filtering features.

classes.name: DBPane
classes.description: Class for managing database panes with tabs for schema and table views.

classes.name: DBSchemaTree
classes.description: ListGrid subclass for displaying database schema tree structure.

classes.name: DataSourceStore
classes.description: DataSource for managing stored data sources.

classes.name: DBCompactList
classes.description: Form for selecting and managing database compact options.

classes.name: DBList
classes.description: Grid listing databases with hover details.

classes.name: SQLBrowser
classes.description: Main class for the SQL Browser interface, managing database and schema views.

methods.name: initWidget
methods.description: Initializes the widget components for various classes.

methods.name: execSQL
methods.description: Executes the SQL query entered in the editor.

methods.name: dsLoaded
methods.description: Callback for when a data source has been loaded.

methods.name: showTableBrowser
methods.description: Displays the table browser for a specific table.

methods.name: showTablePane
methods.description: Displays a specific table's schema and data.
